calculation.expression: active = breadth[t-1] >= max(0.60, rolling_median(breadth[t-1],252)); signal_i[t] = -(return_i[t-1,t-3] - cross_sectional_median(return[t-1,t-3])) when active
calculation.description: When the prior day's fraction of declining assets is above the trailing one-year median and at least 60%, rank assets by contrarian three-day return relative to the contemporaneous cross-sectional median. Inactive dates emit no signal. The signal uses only completed data through t-1 and is evaluated against the next five trading-day return.

validation.regime_notes: 2020-22 IC 0.070805/ICIR 0.196043 (52 dates); 2023-24 IC 0.005236/ICIR 0.026688 (31 dates); 2025-26 IC 0.036974/ICIR 0.081404 (32 dates); no active 2027 dates. Interpret small active-date sample conservatively.
